title: Content mod block (data/<id>/horizon/block/<name>.json)
description: A block of a content mod: a vanilla template block copied under <id>:<name>, with these changed. Reference: docs/mods.md in Horizon.

template.description: The vanilla block it copies: its states, behaviour and sounds (minecraft:iron_block).

hardness.description: Destroy time in seconds of hand mining (-1: unbreakable).

requires_tool.description: Drops only when mined with the right tool.

sounds.description: A vanilla block whose sounds it plays.

shapes.description: Per-state outline and collision boxes, chosen by one state property.

state_properties.description: State properties of its own, which its template does not have (a machine's lit, a pipe's sides).

default_state.description: One value for each declared state property.

item.description: Whether it has an item (placeable, in the creative inventory).

components.description: Its item's data component patch: minecraft:<type> sets one, !minecraft:<type> with {} removes it.
